title: Nayra Markankir Misión
intro: Mä laq’ampi phuqhantat nayra marka, jaqinakapax jan iyawsañan ch’amanchatawa, ukat qhipa iwxt’awix jan ist’ataw uñjasiwayi. Jichhürunakanxa, khitinakatix Allah-an khitatanakap mä qala chuyman jaqinakar mä yatiyäw puriyañatak lurapki ukar mantapxam. Jan iyawsäwit parlir sarnaqäwi, iyawsäwin mä sapa arupa, ukat mä tʼunjir decretompi sellatäki uka tukuyäwi. ¿Khitis uka pʼeqeñchäwinakat parli?
clues: Allah jupaw mä markar khitapxitu, uka markar jaqinakax chiqa yatichäwit jithiqtapxäna
Nayraqatax paniniw jutapxta, ukatx kimsïrix misión ukar ch’amanchañatakiw mayachasipxta
Markachirinakax janiw kunäkisa, jupanakjam jaqinakäpxtwa sasaw sapxitu
Marka jaya chiqat mä sapa almaw t’ijtäna, jaqinakar arktapxam sañataki
Jupanakarux achikt'asipxta, ukampis jupanakax chuymanakap qalarayasisaw nanak contra sayt'asipxäna
Alaxpachat mä tʼunjir jachʼat arnaqasaw markpachax amuktʼayasïna

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Uka Marka Yatiyirinakax Surah Ya-Sin ukan uñt’ayatawa
Uka Hawariyyun (Isa discipulonaka) .
Faraonan Cortepan Layqanaka
Sábado urunkir Compañeronaka
Uka Jaqinakaxa Qhichwa
identity.answer: Uka Marka Yatiyirinakax Surah Ya-Sin ukan uñt’ayatawa

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Markachirinakan jan yäqata ukat k’arisiri sasaw sapxi
Mä jach’a nina nakhantat ninamp jakkir phichhantatänwa
Manqha qutan mä jach’a challwa manq’antatawa
Mä jachʼa pilar lurañatakejj trabajiñar obligatänwa
Mä trinchera ukan t’aqhisiyata, ukax nina nakhantatänwa
trial.answer: Markachirinakan jan yäqata ukat k’arisiri sasaw sapxi

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Nayra marka (al-Qaryah) .
Mä jach’a nina nakhaskir horno
Jach’a challwan purakapa
Alaxpachar llamkt’ir jach’a pilara
Qullan Uta (Kaaba) ukax .

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Markax mä sapa t’unjir arnaqawimpiw t’unjatäna (Sayha) .
Uka tirano ukat ejercitopampiw jaljtat qutan umamp chhaqhayatäpxäna
Jaqinakax monos ukat monos ukar tukupxäna
Alaxpachat qalanak jallu purintatapax markaruw t’unjäna
Mä jach’a uma jalsuw taqpach markarux q’al ch’allxtayäna
outcome.answer: Markax mä sapa t’unjir arnaqawimpiw t’unjatäna (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
